subject.title: Add plan-first Claw status and remove

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this experimental core status/remove and persisted package-ownership contract as the destructive lifecycle for the Claws RFC?
rationale: Tests can establish implementation behavior, but they cannot decide whether core should permanently own plan-bound deletion, package adoption, partial recovery, and cross-installer ledger semantics.

options.title: Sponsor the lifecycle stack
options.body: Approve the ownership and recovery contract, land its prerequisite first, then merge this slice after final stacked validation.

options.title: Land read-only status only
options.body: Keep lifecycle visibility but defer file and package removal until destructive ownership semantics receive separate approval.

options.title: Pause the Claws stack
options.body: Keep the series unmerged if maintainers do not want this grouped lifecycle and persistence model in core.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the lifecycle stack
recommendation.body: Approve the ownership and recovery contract, land its prerequisite first, then merge this slice after final stacked validation.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent shared-state, config-mutation, and filesystem-safety history spans the principal permanent owner boundaries requiring a product decision.
